form.description: Scraped the left rear wheel arch against a concrete pillar while parking at low speed. The body shop says the suspension, exhaust and frame also need work.

form.lossType: Storm damage: windshield shattered by a falling branch

presets.title: Burst pipe (home)
presets.summary: Ceiling water damage below a burst bathroom pipe.

form.description: A supply pipe in the upstairs bathroom burst. We shut off the water within 40 minutes, but the ceiling below was soaked and the paint and drywall are damaged.

form.description: Lost control at night in an empty warehouse lot and hit a wall. Front end, engine and headlights destroyed. Towed by Midnight Towing to Midnight Auto Crafters.
